notes.title: New SCREAMING VOID game
notes.content:
Leaving the dystopian metropolis behind, a strange and dangerous journey lies ahead. You must venture into the depths of the sprawling NEO-INDUSTRIAL tunnels below. Weirdos, Gangs, Mutants, Machines, Traps, Humour & More awaits, as you make your way through...

notes.title: ANNOUNCING NEW GAME very very soon!
notes.content:
Keep your eyes peeled for Screaming Void's new game announcement in the coming days and follow on Twitter.

We have something uber-cool in the works x

notes.title: NoW YoU sEE working on Steamdeck
notes.content:
Although not officially verified yet, NoW YoU sEE does work all the way through on the Steamdeck with zero issues... 

...so if you want to scare yourself at the beach, on the bus or up a creepy tree, now you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34900805/2972f76a051fa325dccb4627b7010461649be1cb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: COLLECTABLES added!
notes.content: As you search the house for a means of escape, keep your eyes peeled for 9 tiny dolls scattered throughout. Can you find them all?
